en: Lava from Taal Volcano is liquid rock that cools into a solid state when it reaches the surface.
Halo-halo is a heterogeneous mixture because you can easily see and separate its different solid ingredients like beans.
Jose Rizal used invisible lemon juice, which undergoes a chemical change when heated, to write secret messages.
The seawater in Boracay Beach is a homogeneous solution where salt is completely dissolved in liquid water.
A Philippine tarsier's diet of insects involves physical changes when its teeth mechanically break solid food into smaller pieces.
The Banaue Rice Terraces are carved into solid rock, demonstrating that earth materials have definite shapes and volumes.
Fermenting sugarcane juice in Ilocos to make basi vinegar is a chemical change that produces a new substance.
Liquid water in the Puerto Princesa Underground River evaporates into a gas state when exposed to cave warmth.
Mud from the mangrove forests of Bohol is a heterogeneous mixture of solid soil particles and liquid water.
Stalactites in Sagada's Sumaging Cave form through a chemical change when dissolved minerals in water precipitate into solid rock.
The Waling-waling orchid's purple petals reflect specific wavelengths of light, demonstrating the physical property of color.
The sweet sap extracted from a coconut tree in Quezon is a liquid solution containing dissolved sugars.
